setName: 2026 Bowman Chrome Baseball (Chrome Prospects Checklist, BCP- prefix)
mintedBy: Bowman-family baseball checklist-gap acquisition (2026-09-21). Diagnosis of a ~300-sale sample of 2026 bowman-chrome unbacked sold_comps rows found 46/300 (15%) unbacked, no wrong-key defect (all correctly minted under setKey=bowman-chrome), dominated by one specific gap: BCP-41 and similar cards' 'Reptilian Refractor' colour parallel is missing at those specific numbers even though card_catalog already carries a large, well-populated Reptilian Refractor ladder (6 colours: Green/Blue/Gold/Orange/Black/Red, 87-135 rows each) for MOST of the 133 distinct BCP- numbers in the catalog. A direct count found 57 of 133 BCP- numbers have ZERO Reptilian Refractor rung of any colour. This package fills exactly those 57 numbers with the SAME 6-colour ladder and print runs already established for the other 76 numbers in card_catalog (confirmed identical across all existing rows: Green /99, Blue /150, Gold /50, Orange /25, Black /10, Red /5) -- no new colours or print runs invented, purely completing a ladder the catalog already recognizes as correct for this product.
cardNumbersFilledListNote: Truncated to the first 30 for readability; the full 57-number list is reconstructable as (all BCP- numbers present under card_catalog setKey=bowman-chrome) minus (BCP- numbers already carrying any Reptilian-named rung). Player names for all 57 were read directly from card_catalog's own existing rows for those numbers (other parallels already on file), not guessed.
spellingAudit: 'Reptilian' (single L) matches card_catalog's own existing spelling for this product (confirmed: 6 colour variants already present, 87-135 rows each, source checklistinsider-2026-08-11/2026-08-27). A DIFFERENT catalog product (setKey=bowman, the flagship non-Chrome BP- rungs) spells the same word 'Reptillian' (double L) -- that is a separate, pre-existing spelling split in a different product this package does not touch or attempt to reconcile.

chromeRefractorLabel.reason: The diagnosis sample also showed BP-102 (Eric Hartman, flagship non-Chrome Bowman) sold under a sale-side parallel label 'Chrome Refractor' with titles carrying no colour/rung information at all ('1st Bowman', 'Bowman Prospects', no serial). checklistinsider's own BP- ladder has no 'Chrome Refractor' rung; this looks like a matcher-side default label rather than a real printed parallel, so no row was minted for it here -- out of scope for a checklist CSV, flagged for the matcher owner.

provenance.playerNamesFrom: card_catalog's own existing rows for each of the 57 filled BCP- numbers (their other, already-catalogued parallels), read via a bounded query, sport=baseball/cardYear=2026/setKey=bowman-chrome
provenance.rungsFrom: card_catalog's own existing Reptilian Refractor ladder for the other 76 BCP- numbers in the same product (6 colours, print runs cross-checked for consistency across all existing rows before reuse) -- not re-scraped, since the ladder was already verified present and correctly spelled in the live catalog; the source page (2026-bowman-baseball, 'Chrome Prospects Checklist' section) independently confirms 'Reptilian Refractor (1:10 Hobby; 1:13 Jumbo; 1:6 Blaster)' as a stated rung, corroborating the catalog's own data.
provenance.dedup: existing card_catalog rows for setKey=bowman-chrome, sport=baseball, cardYear=2026, cardNumber LIKE 'BCP-%' were read via a bounded query pass (6,177 total bowman-chrome rows) and only the 57 numbers with zero Reptilian rung were filled.
